a2_level1_one_effect_at_a_time (tier T2.purpose: attribute the residual to named mechanisms by switching one omitted effect back on at a time in the Level-1 deck: LAMBDA; CGDO and CGSO; CJ; default IS
a2_level1_one_effect_at_a_time (tier T2.report: for each: the sandwich residual against the box tube, the four margins, min/max of v(out) and the delays; to be compared with the Python sensitivity study (07_sensitivity), which predicts the LAMBDA and gate-drain results

dc.quantity: r(u, v) = 1e6 * i(VOUT) [uA] - I_net(u, v; theta) from experiments/v2b/laws.py
dc.report: max |r| over the grid per corner; pass criterion (harness check): max |r| < 1e-3 uA; any larger value means a units or sign error, a non-zero LAMBDA/GAMMA, or junction/GMIN leakage and must be explained before anything else is compared
dc.sweep: v in [-0.1, 2.08] step 0.02 V; u in [-0.5, 2.48] step 0.05 V; all 32 corners

a_level1_matched.purpose: units, sign-convention and harness cross-check of the Python simulator against an independent implementation of the same equations; not physical evidence

transient.cases: all 32 corners at C = C_max, both transitions, constant disturbance at the adverse bound (w = -eps for the rise, +eps for the fall), input ramp 2 V/ns from the opposite rail to the band edge, start at the far end of the safe domain
transient.quantity: crossing time of V_OH (rise) / V_OL (fall) after s, by linear interpolation of the 1 ps output samples, minus the Python reference (DOP853, rtol 1e-12); max |v_spice(t) - v_python(t)| on the sample grid
transient.report: difference in ns and in V; expected at the level of the SPICE tolerances (RELTOL 1e-6). The device capacitances must be confirmed zero first (`show`).

b_higher_fidelity (tier T3).conditions: process corners tt, ss, ff, sf, fs; supply at VDD_min, nominal, VDD_max; -40, 27, 100 C (docs/model.md 9.4)

quantities: sandwich residual r(u, v) = distance of I_spice(u, v) from [min_theta I_net(u, v; theta), max_theta I_net(u, v; theta)] over the box (and over the box members at the run's own supply); max over the grid versus eps_I

the four margins directly on the SPICE map: min net pull-up for u <= V_IL, v <= V_OH (versus I_up(V_OH) and eps_I); min net pull-down for u >= V_IH, v >= V_OL (versus I_dn(V_OL)); min restoring current over u at v = V_lo and at v = V_hi (versus the R bounds and eps_I)
square-law extractions of docs/model.md 9.5 items 1-3 (saturation extrapolation, linear extrapolation, envelope fits), each reported separately
dc.report: each quantity with the grid point and condition that is worst. These are statistics of a finite grid: a grid can refute a bound, it cannot establish one between grid points, corners or temperatures.
dc.sweep: (u, v) in [-0.1, 2.08]^2 step 0.02 V for every condition

b_higher_fidelity (tier T3).purpose: physical-evidence dimension: does a separately sourced transistor model satisfy the obligation of interface.md v1 (rev. 2), i.e. lie inside the tube spanned by the parameter box up to eps_m, with eps_m + eps_w <= eps_I and C in [C_min, C_max]?

transient.cases: full-swing input ramps at several slew rates, external load at C_min and C_max, both polarities, every condition
quantities: delay from the input crossing V_IL / V_IH to the output crossing V_OH / V_OL, versus tau_up / tau_dn
min and max of v(out) versus [V_lo, V_hi] (gate-drain feedthrough overshoot is expected at fast edges; the formal model has no such coupling)
inclusion residual along the waveform: distance of dv/dt from the set {(I_net(u, v; theta) + w) / c : theta in the box, |w| <= eps_I, c in [C_min, C_max]}
incremental capacitances dQ/dv and dQ/du at the output (docs/model.md 9.5 item 5) versus [C_min, C_max] and the feedthrough budget
transient.report: each quantity with the run that maximises it; a violation here is a finding about model fidelity or about the design record, not about the Lean theorem
